confirmedFindings.summary: Access-token issuers and verifiers now emit and require the RFC 9068 at+jwt media type while rejecting legacy JWT headers.
testEvidence: plasius-ltd-site ChatGPT MCP OAuth integration tests
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved on the authoritative main branches and released for package consumers.

confirmedFindings.summary: The incomplete optional DPoP path was removed from advertised behavior and now fails closed; the issuer does not claim RFC 9449 support.
testEvidence: oauth2-issuer DPoP fail-closed and metadata tests
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved by disabling the incomplete mode; a future complete implementation requires separate governed work.

confirmedFindings.summary: Confidential-client token exchanges authenticate registered secrets with a constant-time digest comparison before issuing tokens.
testEvidence: oauth2-issuer confidential-client authorization-code and refresh-token tests
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved on main and released in @plasius/oauth2-issuer.

confirmedFindings.summary: The public ACA frontend boundary emits the adopted max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains HSTS policy on static, health, and proxied responses.
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved through the approved production CD path with a release-blocking live-header check.

confirmedFindings.summary: Offline cache implementations refuse request and response no-store entries, remove legacy entries, and cover all supported cache strategies.
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved on the authoritative main branches and released for package consumers.

confirmedFindings.summary: Schema and translations now share a documented, case-insensitive RFC 5646 subset; full IANA registry membership remains intentionally outside the validator.
testEvidence: translations public-boundary and URL-construction validation tests
confirmedFindings.remediation: Safe interoperability and documentation gaps are resolved; the remaining partial state records the explicit registry-membership limitation.

confirmedFindings.summary: Login return paths encode UTF-8 bytes with unpadded base64url and reject malformed state before navigation.
testEvidence: auth Unicode and malformed base64url login-state tests
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved on main and released in @plasius/auth.

confirmedFindings.summary: Retry-After parsing requires integer delay-seconds, supports all HTTP-date forms, rejects malformed values, and enforces an operational cap.
testEvidence: analytics Retry-After grammar and three HTTP-date form tests
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved on the authoritative main branches and released for package consumers.

confirmedFindings.summary: The compatibility-named public validator documents RFC 9562 and accepts versions 1 through 8 plus Nil and Max UUID values.
testEvidence: schema RFC 9562 version, Nil, Max, and invalid UUID fixtures
confirmedFindings.remediation: Resolved on main and released in @plasius/schema while preserving the compatibility filename.
